freshness_context.summary: 2025-2026 industry has converged on patterns that directly validate the spec's core design: fractal loop architecture, LLM-as-controller, dream loop memory consolidation, and semantic circuit breakers. Key findings below are compressed for downstream Solution Pro consumption.

key_findings: Industry shift from monolithic single agents to multi-agent teams with specialized roles (researcher, coder, analyst, coordinator) — validates spec's Orchestrator→Workers pattern
Event-Driven Architectures (EDA) emerging as key for scaling agents and dynamic context-driven workflows — aligns with spec's event-triggered routines
Production-grade agents now use 3-layer architecture: perception (context ingestion), memory (state persistence), action (sandboxed execution) — maps to spec's layers
LLMs driving dynamic control logic instead of rigid programming — directly validates spec's '全LLM控制，Python不做控制流' constraint
Agent Harness layer emerging for control/governance at scale — spec's direction_guard references DeepFlow Harness, industry confirms this pattern
self_correction_patterns: Reflection + in-loop feedback: agents analyze actions and receive feedback for prompt-level improvements without altering model weights
Self-generated data and curricula: agents generate own training data for continuous improvement — aligns with spec's Dream Loop
Self-adapting code agents (2025-2026 breakthrough): agents can fine-tune, edit, rewrite own code/policies — validates spec's 'Agent可修改自己的Skill'
Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) transitioning from theory to tangible research in 2026
circuit_breaker_design: Traditional binary circuit breakers insufficient for AI — need semantic failure detection (hallucinations, reasoning loops) even when system returns 'success'
New pattern: 3-state machine — closed/open/degraded — allows partial capability during issues
Layered circuit breakers: execution time (TTL), budget (cost), output quality (semantics) — spec should incorporate all 3 dimensions
AI Agent Gateways: intercept tool invocations, evaluate against policies, approve/block in real-time — proactive vs reactive security
GitHub Copilot infrastructure collapse (April 2026) cited as example of unconstrained agentic workloads — validates spec's '必须有死循环熔断机制'

key_findings: Bio-inspired memory architectures: capture execution traces → consolidate through 'dream cycles' akin to human NREM/REM sleep — directly validates spec's Dream Loop concept
Anthropic 'Claude Dreaming' (May 2026): maintenance process for external memory, reorganizes/cleans memory store by processing past sessions — industry validation of dream loop pattern
'Sleep' paradigm for LLMs (June 2026): 2 stages — (1) memory consolidation: distill short-term → stable long-term knowledge, (2) dreaming: generate synthetic data to rehearse + refine capabilities

Sleep-Consolidated Memory (SCM) architecture (April 2026): working memory limits + NREM/REM consolidation + intentional forgetting + self-model → perfect recall on multi-turn benchmarks with reduced memory noise
Meta-Policy Reflexion (Sept 2025): consolidates reflections into structured Meta-Policy Memory → reusable knowledge to reduce repeated mistakes
Experiential Reflective Learning ERL (March 2026): reflect on past outcomes/trajectories → generate transferable heuristics for rapid adaptation
Self-Reflective Memory Architecture SRMA (2025): episodic encoding + reflection scoring + adaptive retrieval + energy-based correction → coherence over long reasoning cycles

Hybrid memory systems (2025): combine episodic (specific experiences) + semantic (generalized knowledge) + intelligent decay + consolidation — spec's memory/loops/ structure should incorporate these memory types
design_implications_for_spec: Dream Loop phases should map to NREM (consolidation/pruning) + REM (synthetic rehearsal) — not just generic 'reflection'
Memory types should be explicitly separated: working (current task), episodic (past executions), semantic (learned patterns/procedures)
Intentional forgetting mechanism needed — not just accumulation, but pruning of low-value memories
Meta-Policy Memory pattern: consolidate reflections into reusable structured policies (maps to spec's Skill Workshop evolution)

key_findings: Hierarchical Orchestration pattern: top-level orchestrator delegates to intermediate sub-orchestrators — directly maps to spec's 3-layer fractal (Project→Domain→Phase)
Orchestrator-Worker pattern: central orchestrator breaks down tasks, delegates to specialized workers, aggregates results — spec's core pattern validated
Debate/Maker-Checker loops: one agent generates, another validates — reduces hallucinations, improves quality — aligns with spec's quality verification requirement
Durable execution engines: persist workflow state, enable deterministic replay — critical for spec's 'Loop状态跨Session存活，中断后可恢复'
Separated evaluation: 3-agent setup (planner + generator + separate evaluator) — validates spec's LLM-as-Judge quality gates
Intelligent escalation: agents recognize uncertainty, escalate to humans, then resume without losing progress — aligns with spec's HITL timeout + auto-escalation
Multi-agent systems market: Gartner reports 1,445% surge in MAS inquiries Q1 2024 → Q2 2025 — validates timing and relevance
Key challenge: many MAS still have high failure rates due to poor system design, coordination gaps, weak verification — spec must address these
A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol emerging as standard for cross-framework communication — spec should consider for Hermes integration
long_running_best_practices: Durability: survive crashes, retries, partial completion via persistent state
Memory separation: working/episodic/semantic/procedural for extended context retention
Goal-oriented execution loops: analyze → explore → implement → test → debug → iterate
Dynamic adaptability: adapt to changing conditions/new info over long durations
Secure sandboxed execution environments for code generation
Cost optimization: match model size to task complexity, caching, token monitoring
